about: Browse (BROWSE-2): BrowseRules in src/LifeOs.Api/Read/BrowseReader.cs, which GET /api/browse answers with, and the mock's copy in web/src/lib/mock/browse.ts. Each page case is a query over the items, on a day, and answers the type list's held counts, the totals, the filter options, the columns and the rows' ids in order. Entered counts days in the home zone; the items are entered at noon UTC, so the day is the same in any zone the tests run in.
